svg.title: invoke
svg.desc: invoke: a recorded terminal session, 22 s, looping. Steps: a new shell loads the block setup wrote in ~/.bashrc / claude invoke rhizo · the example soul / claude invoke with no soul, and with one that does not exist / plain claude: the core prompt, no soul
